title: HIM 101 - Introduction to Health Information Management

items.q: Which statement correctly defines Master patient index?
o: the mean number of days patients spend in hospital

a book or file in which events are entered in date order
the process of giving record content to an authorised requester
items.s: Master patient index: the register listing every patient with the number assigned to them. The other options describe Register, Average length of stay, Release of information.

items.q: The correct meaning of Daily census is
